# Rejected engine-selected Record: sustained cache churn

Two fresh processes per entry/engine/encoding, opposite order. 500,000 distinct eight-letter pieces in 500-piece blocks; 100,000-entry cache. The fill phase precedes four 100,000-piece churn phases. Each encode is followed immediately by count on the same block, so count measures hits warmed by encode. Timings include the public method and result allocation; exact token checks occur outside timing. Encode and count remain separate metrics. The combined time improves on Node, but does not cancel count regressions.
